subject: Project update and one unclear instruction
text:
Hello,

I want to send this before I forget the details and keep the update short. The shared garden project is still on track for the weekend. We have the mulch delivered, and the first group of volunteers confirmed for Saturday morning. That part is done. The bench staining also moved forward, although we paused after one coat because the weather report changed and the second coat may need to dry fully.

The one issue is the instruction about the side fence panels. Your message said to 'sort the remaining boards before noon', but I am not sure what you mean by 'remaining boards.' Are you referring only to the unpainted boards waiting by the gate, or are you asking us to move every loose board out of the way because the paint crew might need room? If you meant the first option, we can do it quickly. If you meant the second option, we should probably wait until the crew confirms its arrival time so we do not create another shuffle.

I can take care of either option today, but I do not want to create another shuffle. Please reply with one short sentence and I will follow it exactly.

Thanks,
